courses.title: Practice It: Advanced SQL
courses.why: Guided exercises on window functions, CTEs, subqueries and date handling: the exact query patterns live SQL rounds use, in under half an hour.

courses.title: Advanced SQL for Query Tuning and Performance Optimization
courses.why: Reading execution plans and applying indexing, join, partitioning and materialised-view strategies in PostgreSQL: the 'how do you fix a slow query' answer, with depth.

courses.title: Level Up: PostgreSQL
courses.why: A short set of PostgreSQL challenges from querying to data management and administration, run in GitHub Codespaces with nothing to install.

portals.name: LeetCode: SQL 50 study plan
portals.what: 50 curated SQL problems (selects, joins, aggregation, subqueries, window functions); the standard warm-up before a SQL screen.

portals.name: HackerRank: SQL practice
portals.what: Graded problems from basic select to advanced join, on the same platform as the HackerRank SQL certificates.

portals.name: PostgreSQL Exercises
portals.what: Free exercises on one realistic dataset: joins and subqueries, modifying data, aggregates, dates, strings and recursive queries, all in PostgreSQL.

portals.name: DataLemur: SQL interview questions
portals.what: Around 250 real interview questions from large tech companies, tagged by difficulty; many are free, some need a paid plan.

portals.name: PostgreSQL tutorial (official docs)
portals.what: The official tutorial for the current release (PostgreSQL 18): basics, joins, aggregates, transactions and window functions.

assessments.name: HackerRank SQL (Basic) certificate
assessments.format: 30-minute online test, 2 problems on simple queries
assessments.why: A quick first SQL credential; take it the same evening you do the intermediate one.

assessments.name: HackerRank SQL (Intermediate) certificate
assessments.format: 35-minute online test, 2 problems built around complex joins
assessments.why: Shows you can write the multi-table queries interviewers ask for, in a short timed setting.

assessments.name: HackerRank SQL (Advanced) certificate
assessments.format: 60-minute online test, 2 problems including query optimisation
assessments.why: The top HackerRank SQL tier; the one worth featuring on LinkedIn for a senior engineer.

assessments.name: freeCodeCamp Relational Databases certification
assessments.format: Five certification projects (PostgreSQL, Bash, Git) plus a 50-question timed exam taken in freeCodeCamp's exam environment
assessments.credential: Verified freeCodeCamp certification with a public URL
assessments.why: A project-based credential: the five projects themselves are evidence you can design and query PostgreSQL databases.
